oi_agg.sql: SELECT count(distinct symbol), count(*), max(ts) FROM oi_history

funding_stale_groupby.sql: SELECT symbol FROM (SELECT symbol, max(funding_time) as max_ft FROM funding_history GROUP BY symbol) WHERE max_ft < ?
